student_passage:
Last (1) ____（星期六）, I helped my (2) ____（叔叔） deliver a large cake to a community hall. It was the (3) ____（第三） cake he had made that morning, but the only one with three layers. He put it in a tall box so that the top would not touch the lid.

It was raining when we left, so I carried an (4) ____（雨伞）. We used the side door near the hall's (5) ____（厨房）. The path was narrow, and we walked (6) ____（慢慢地）. No other helpers were there yet, so we had to carry the box by (7) ____（我们自己）. We could not hurry (8) ____（因为） a sudden movement might damage the soft layers.

Inside, a woman showed us the cake table. There were five paper (9) ____（花） on the wall behind it, but no other decorations. My uncle lifted off the box while I held the lid. The cake had arrived safely. After another ten minutes, the hall doors (10) ____（终于） opened. We stood back as the first guests came in and noticed the cake.
